title: Bulk Order Response
description: Represents a bulk order for physical card shipments

token.description: Globally unique identifier for the bulk order

status.description: Status of the bulk order. OPEN indicates the order is accepting cards. LOCKED indicates the order is finalized and no more cards can be added

shipping_address.description: Shipping address for all cards in this bulk order

shipping_method.description: Shipping method for all cards in this bulk order. BULK_PRIORITY, BULK_2_DAY, and BULK_EXPRESS are only available with Perfect Plastic Printing

customer_product_id.description: Customer-specified product configuration for physical card manufacturing. This must be configured with Lithic before use

card_tokens.description: List of card tokens associated with this bulk order

created.description: An RFC 3339 timestamp for when the bulk order was created. UTC time zone

updated.description: An RFC 3339 timestamp for when the bulk order was last updated. UTC time zone
